'''Roeg''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] stationed aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He had his own personal guard on the station.<ref name="Escape">''[[Escape from the Death Star]]''</ref>
